summary: Graphviz 16.1.0-2 Perl binding unavailable with znver4 Perl 5.42; verified package rollback restores it
changes: Refreshed configured repositories and ran full pacman -Syu. Only Graphviz changed from 16.1.0-1 to 16.1.0-2. Diagnosed a Perl binding regression and restored Graphviz 16.1.0-1 using a preserved package validated by pacman. Final installed-package inventory matches the initial inventory. Package databases, cached downloads and private audit records remain updated. Preserved monitored KDE, keyboard, repository and service configuration hashes. No reboot or persistent configuration edit.
problem: The configured cachyos-core-znver4 repository has priority over core and supplies Perl 5.42.3-1.1, while core advertises Perl 5.44.0-1. Graphviz 16.1.0-2 from extra installs its gv Perl binding under the 5.44 vendor directory. The active Perl 5.42 interpreter cannot locate gv.pm. The previous Graphviz 16.1.0-1 package contains a 5.42 binding. Evidence indicates repository version skew.
solution: Tested temporary workaround: restore the preserved Graphviz 16.1.0-1 package with pacman -U. The gv import succeeds again and the old-module hook warning disappears. Keep repository priorities unchanged; reassess once compatible repository packages are available. No permanent pin, interpreter replacement or source rebuild was applied.
reproduction: On the observed system with cachyos-core-znver4 before core, confirm Perl 5.42.3-1.1 and Graphviz 16.1.0-1. Run a full pacman -Syu when extra offers Graphviz 16.1.0-2. The transaction updates Graphviz alone. Run perl -Mgv -e 1: it fails to locate gv.pm. Package ownership and file lists show the new binding targets Perl 5.44 while the previous package targets 5.42. After restoring the previous Graphviz package, the same import succeeds.
tests: Before update: pacman -Dk passed; pacman -Qkk graphviz reported 453 files and zero altered files; dot generated valid SVG; no failed system units. After update: database, package integrity and SVG checks passed, but gv import failed with exit 2. After rollback: gv import passed with exit 0, valid SVG generated, database and package integrity passed, no failed units, final package inventory and monitored configuration hashes match baseline. Graphviz 16.1.0-2 remains an advertised update. An unrelated notice that installed libclc 23.1.3-3 is newer than the configured repository version was recorded without downgrading it.
rollback: The Graphviz-only rollback was executed successfully using the previously downloaded and validated 16.1.0-1 package. Signature and integrity checks remained enabled. No broader restore was needed. Future upgrade is deferred pending compatible Graphviz and Perl packages.
